title: Nearby stays on a map
description: Browse external accommodation options with Stay22. Existing hotel search and manual selection remain available.
privacy: Loading or opening this map sends this public area, available dates, guest counts and your IP/device information to Stay22 and its providers, which may use cookies. Your trip ID, title, notes and private places are not included.
disclosure: We may earn a commission from bookings through this map, at no extra cost to you.
limitations: Prices and availability are supplied by external platforms; confirm dates, guests, taxes, fees and cancellation terms before booking. Map selections do not reserve a room or update your trip or budget.
datesMissing: Valid future stay dates are missing. No dates will be sent; choose and confirm them in the map before comparing prices.
guestsMissing: Guest details are incomplete. No guest counts will be sent; confirm the map's defaults before comparing prices.
children: Child ages are not sent. Check child occupancy and ages on the booking platform.
slow: The map may be slow or blocked. You can open it separately or continue with the existing hotel search.
open: Open Stay22 map in a new tab
manual: Found a hotel? Add it manually
blocked: Your browser requests Do Not Track or Global Privacy Control. The embedded affiliate map is disabled; you can still use the existing hotel tools.
